title: the casting door refuses decisions a rehearsal cannot read
intention: cast_ticket refuses a ticket whose decisions are not a list of {n: int, text: non-blank string} with distinct n, naming each bad entry, so no decision a rehearsal cannot read enters the store.
why: Measured 2026-11-04 on 3dc005de27cf pass 1: the cast accepted plain-string decisions, the rehearsal's labeled() (cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py:452) reads only dicts with an int n, so every decision was dropped and the reader reported 'the plan has no steps'; 5183005fa134's first rehearsal read zero steps the same way. 4 of 362 tickets with decisions carry strings (measured 2026-11-05).
traces_to: Law 7 (a silently dropped decision reads as an empty plan, not a loud refusal) and Law 4 (the decision shape is enforced by the casting door, not remembered by the caster).
how: Add a lack check (d3) to cast_ticket in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py after (d2): when the doc carries decisions, not a list is one lack; each entry that is not a dict with an int n >= 1 (bool excluded) and a non-blank string text is a lack naming its index; a repeated n is a lack naming it. The door already refuses with every lack in one pass and writes nothing.
falsifier: Done when (1) cast_ticket over a doc whose decisions hold a plain string raises CastRefused naming that entry's index and writes no file; (2) a dict entry without an int n, or with a blank text, is refused the same way; (3) two entries sharing an n are refused; (4) well-formed decisions {n, text, ...} and a doc with no decisions still cast as before. Horizon: the next cast carrying decisions. Wrong intent if Akien wants strings normalized rather than refused.

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (exists; measured 2026-11-05: def cast_ticket at line 2236, the comment '# (d2) the model the ticket's work runs on' at line 2286, '    if lacks:' at line 2307 followed by 'raise CastRefused(lacks)'), insert a lack check commented '# (d3)' immediately before the (e) block that precedes line 2307: if 'decisions' is in the doc and is not None, a non-list value adds the lack 'decisions is not a list'; for each entry at index i, an entry that is not a dict, or whose n is not an int >= 1 (a bool is not an int here), or whose text is not a non-blank string, adds a lack naming 'decisions[i]' and repr(entry)[:80]; an int n seen twice adds a lack naming D<n>. The lacks join the existing list, so the existing 'if lacks: raise CastRefused(lacks)' refuses them. One docstring sentence names the new refusal.

D2: red-first proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_cast_refuses_decisions_a_rehearsal_cannot_read.py with PROVES = {'6d81b55be139': {'1': ..., '2': ..., '3': ..., '4': ...}} keyed to falsifier clauses 1-4. It copies the harness of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_cast_seeds_decisions_from_builder_check.py: a scratch commons from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir with tickets/_charter+why.json copied from the live charter (home checkout when the worktree has none), cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.set_diagnostic_roots pointed at it and restored in finally, and a _doc() with agreeing sorted and intent berths; cast_ticket is imported inside each tooth. Fixture ids are 6d810000a001 onward. Tooth 1: decisions ['D1: a string'] raises CastRefused whose lacks name 'decisions[0]', and no file for the id is in the scratch tickets dir. Tooth 2: decisions [{'text': 'no n'}] and [{'n': 1, 'text': '  '}] each raise CastRefused naming decisions[0]. Tooth 3: [{'n':1,'text':'a'},{'n':1,'text':'b'}] raises CastRefused naming D1. Tooth 4: [{'n':1,'text':'D1: a','by':'cc','source':'cast'}] casts and lands byte-identical, and a doc with no decisions casts.

D3: steps: commit the red-first proof (teeth 1-3 red, tooth 4 green before the build), make the D1 edit, run cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_cast_refuses_decisions_a_rehearsal_cannot_read.py and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_cast_ticket.py and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_cast_seeds_decisions_from_builder_check.py twice under bin/cairn test, then predict with bin/cairn test --hollow 6d81b55be139 --proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_cast_refuses_decisions_a_rehearsal_cannot_read.py before PROVEME.
